finding.summary: The _Trickle class uses class-level mutable state (stop Event, finish_after, line) that is shared across all test instances. The trickle fixture creates a subclass Handler that overrides stop, but finish_after and line remain class variables on _Trickle. If tests run in parallel or sequentially without proper reset, state leaks between tests.
finding.fix: Move stop, finish_after, and line to instance variables in __init__, or ensure each test gets a completely fresh handler class. The fixture already creates a new Handler class per test, but _Trickle.line and _Trickle.finish_after are still shared class variables.
